cells.requirement: Residential rental property owners are prohibited from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices, and software providers are prohibited from facilitating price coordination among competing landlords.

Housing providers are prohibited from inquiring about or considering an applicant's criminal record prior to issuing a conditional offer of rental housing, with limited exceptions for certain methamphetamine production and lifetime sex offender registration requirements.
Landlords and their agents cannot charge a residential rental application or screening fee exceeding $50, subject to annual Consumer Price Index adjustments.
Landlords are prohibited from charging a security deposit exceeding one and one-half times one month's rent, and must return the deposit with interest within 30 days after tenancy termination.

Landlords are prohibited from discriminating in housing accommodations based on protected classes including race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, and source of lawful income.
Newly constructed multiple dwellings are exempt from local rent control ordinances for a period of 30 years following completion of construction.

Landlords may not remove residential tenants or fail to renew leases except for specific statutory grounds of good cause, and must provide relocation assistance equal to six times monthly rent if displacing tenants for illegal occupancy where the municipality has no ordinance.
